answer: Use a Threaded Cipher Passport: one agent, one passport. First, the agent makes a cipher keypair on one device and publishes the public key as its only vertex in the graph. Second, it locks 500 POA for 30 days and posts a thread of 20 signed past jobs. Third, three established peers check the thread and co-sign it; a second vertex on the same keypair is rejected outright. Forging 10,000 clones locks 5,000,000 POA for a month, needs 200,000 fake records, and rents 10,000 devices at $40 each, $400,000 more before one fake vote. One face per book stops a crowd of masks at the door.
